title: Stratified Reranker benchmark and A/B KPI pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reproducible benchmark and A/B telemetry pipeline for reranking endpoints that measures NDCG/MRR on customer prompt-sets, captures latency/kv-cache warmup behavior, and supports canary rollout hooks in Console. This ticket ties together offline eval harness, production telemetry events, and an A/B gating rule for automatic rollback when quality regresses beyond thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Offline harness can replay customer prompt-sets and compute NDCG@10 and MRR@10 for pointwise and pairwise reranker variants.
Telemetry events emitted from production rerank flow: rerank.request_id, rerank.candidate_count, rerank.ndcg, rerank.mrr, rerank.latency_ms, rerank.kvcache_hit_rate.
Dashboards show rolling 24h and 7d NDCG/MRR deltas per model variant and per-customer cohort.
A/B test hooks implemented so Console can route X% of traffic to candidate model and collect per-request labels for offline scoring.
Canary automation fails fast: if NDCG drop > 0.015 and customer_impact=high cohort impacted, the rollout flags for rollback and notifies on-call.
End-to-end latency P50/P95 for reranking path documented and not regressed more than 10% vs baseline when enabling distributed scoring for >1000 candidates.
implementation_steps: 1) Offline harness: extend existing rerank eval runner to support stratified customer prompt-sets and sampling seeds for deterministic runs.
2) Instrumentation: add structured telemetry events in rerank service and embed trace ids for correlation (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rerank-service/pull/845).
3) Scale shim: implement candidate-shard scoring to limit per-worker memory and enable parallel scoring for large candidate sets.
4) KV cache warmup scenarios: add synthetic warm/cold sequences to harness to measure first-request penalty and steady-state.
5) Dashboard + alerts: create Grafana panels and threshold alert for ndcg.delta and mrr.delta (dashboard id: rwd-dash-nt-12).
6) Console A/B hooks: expose rollout knobs and event sink to capture ground-truth clicks/labels for offline eval.
7) Canary plan: staged rollout (1%, 5%, 25%) with automated checks and manual approval gate at 25%.
8) Run customer-focused dry-run with two pilot customers, collect feedback, and update prompt-sets accordingly.
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: Use stratified customer prompt-sets rather than a single pooled set to surface cohort-specific regressions; increases complexity of harness but yields higher signal for enterprise customers.

Compare pointwise vs pairwise training/eval approaches: pairwise shows better MRR in prior experiments but increases inference cost; we will include both in pipeline and add cost-per-token telemetry to decisioning.
Implementing distributed candidate-shard scoring trades lower latency for more RPCs when candidate counts are small; we will auto-enable shard mode only when candidate_count > 400.
KV cache warmup instrumentation adds overhead to produce metrics; use sampled tracing (1%) in high-volume customers and full traces for pilot customers.
metrics_and_targets: Baseline NDCG@10 (current prod) = 0.312 (global pooled), target improvement >= +0.010 for candidate model
Latency budget for rerank path (including embedding fetch + scoring): P50 < 45ms, P95 < 220ms (goal), allow +10% during canary for stock tests
KV cache hit-rate target in steady-state >= 0.78 for common prompt prefixes
A/B telemetry sample size target per-week per-cohort >= 10k requests to reach significance for NDCG deltas at alpha=0.05
testing_and_validation: Run offline runs against last 90 days of ingested customer prompt sets; store run artifacts and seed so runs are reproducible (confluence: /docs/rerank/harness-reproducibility).
Run synthetic stress tests to validate shard scoring at candidate_count=2000 and ensure memory per-worker < 8GB.
Smoke test end-to-end with pilot customer A and B: validate telemetry matching offline labels and that click signals are attached to request ids.
AB significance check implemented in Eval pipeline: compute bootstrap confidence intervals for NDCG and MRR deltas.
discussion_notes: PM (Ravi Kumar): prioritize enterprise cohort detection so we can block models that harm revenue customers.
Data Science (Lena Sato): recommended stratified bucketing by vertical and token-length distribution to avoid pooled bias.
Infra (Marco Li): shard scoring approach will require a new lightweight RPC contract; prototype PR attached.
Design (Olivia Chen): Console UX needs a simple pass/fail summary and links to cohort-level breakdowns; will provide mocks next sprint.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: False positives in small-cohort A/B tests. Mitigation: require min sample size and use bootstrap CIs before gating.
Risk: Increased latency due to shard RPCs for medium-sized candidate sets. Mitigation: auto-threshold to disable shard mode for candidate_count < 400 and micro-benchmark in CI.
Risk: Telemetry overhead. Mitigation: use sampled tracing and batch telemetry flush; measure overhead in pilot customers.
Risk: Customer privacy for prompt-sets. Mitigation: PII scrubber in ingest pipeline and encryption-at-rest; pilot agreements required.
notes: This ticket is a cross-team coordination piece. Follow-ups will split infra (shard scoring), telemetry (events and dashboards), and console (AB controls). Plan to iterate rapidly with two pilot customers before a wider Dedicated rollout.
